definitions.explanation: A patient's first visit to a particular doctor or hospital, or the first consultation for a new condition.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}の{方|かた}は{受付|うけつけ}にお{申|もう}し{出|で}ください。
examples.english: First-time patients, please check in at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}には{保険証|ほけんしょう}を{持参|じさん}してください。
examples.english: Please bring your insurance card for your first visit.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}{料|りょう}は{再診|さいしん}{料|りょう}より{高|たか}いことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The initial consultation fee is often higher than the follow-up fee.

notes:
USAGE:
{初診|しょしん} is commonly seen on signs and forms at hospitals and clinics in Japan. Patients are typically divided into {初診|しょしん} (first-time) and {再診|さいしん} (returning) at the reception desk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初診|しょしん}{料|りょう} (initial consultation fee)
- {初診|しょしん}の{患者|かんじゃ} (first-time patient)
- {初診|しょしん}{予約|よやく} (first-visit appointment)

RELATED WORDS:
- {再診|さいしん} (follow-up visit, return visit)
- {紹介状|しょうかいじょう} (referral letter — often needed for a first visit to a large hospital)
